high_level_description: The image shows a computer screen with a webpage open from the website "fondazione-fair.it/progetto/." The webpage is related to the FAIR (Future Artificial Intelligence Research) project, which focuses on modern Artificial Intelligence and its various theoretical, modeling, and engineering aspects. The project aims to contribute to addressing research questions, methodologies, models, technologies, without neglecting ethical and legal rules, and sustainability issues in a broad sense, not only environmental. The webpage includes a description of the FAIR project's goals and approach.
